source: QuantMind 训练特征构筑 session 10-14 (D1 revision); fixed before any 2021-23 state number exists

H1.claim: |mean IC| in up_highvol < |mean IC| of the other three states pooled

H2.claim: mean IC in down_highvol < mean IC of the other three states pooled

span: V4 grid (fwd_wx, delisting layer), TOP100, lag 1, signal hours 2021-01-01 00:00 .. t + 168 h < 2024-01-01
threshold: 0.005196 = V2 TRAIN median, recomputed exactly on the old TRAIN; state rule, window, cells as V2
test: one-sided segment block bootstrap, B 10000, seed 20261015: d = f(m_state) - f(m_rest), f = abs for H1, identity for H2; rest = the three other states, each resampled separately then pooled; p = P*(d* >= 0); pass if p < 0.05
untestable: any of the four states with < 4 segments in the span -> 测不了, not 没过
excluded: OI / LS cells are not tested (2021 about 10 % present)
disclosure: COMBO_V1 had already computed 2021-23 per-year cell ICs on V4 (not split by state) before this
use: pass -> fixed state switch (state weight x 0) in the V4 weight layer, COMBO_V2 only, nothing tuned; both fail -> regime line closed, only D2 beta neutral kept; no retry with other definitions
